top_signals.title: Public sector makes wage growth higher than expected
top_signals.summary: Wage growth was higher than expected as pay offers in the public sector far outweighed growth in the private sector, new data has revealed.  Official statistics have shown that wage growth, including bonuses, reached 4.1 per cent between April and June compared to a market forecast of four per cent. This was still lower than [...]
